title: Nonempty-open unit for a normal constant sheaf
statement: Let Y be an integral scheme whose local rings are integrally closed, let j : U ⟶ Y be a nonempty open immersion, and let M be a module over a commutative ring Λ. The unit from the constant Λ-module sheaf on Y to its pushforward along j is an isomorphism.

proof.text: A nonempty open subscheme of an integral scheme contains the generic point. Repeat the strict-henselian normal-domain calculation on the affine etale basis of the open; the unit is an isomorphism on every basis object and hence of sheaves.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09Z5, split from the nonempty-open conjunct
